g.text: ▲ NORTH: THE COAST WAY (To Ash Grove 7,6)
Old Jonas & Little Maya • 11:00 AM Muster
Sister Althea • Deep Shelter Crypts Below
Tobias the Baker • DC 12 Con / 13 Dex
Chartered Crossroads of the Coast Way • Hex (8, 10)
I. CIVIC, NORTH & EAST QUARTER LANDMARKS (#1 – #6)
1. North Gatehouse & Checkpoint: Twin-tower portcullis gate; Constable Renwick's ledger.
2. The Grand Clocktower & Belfry: 150-ft horological spire; Artificer Bram Copperwheel.
3. Feldepost Square & Municipal Well: Central well, Old Jonas, Little Maya & 11:00 AM Muster.
4. Song of the Morning Church: Temple of Lathander (Sister Althea) & deep shelter crypts.
5. Thunderhammer Smithy & Coal-Yard: Master Smith Taerom's great forge & back coal-yard.
6. Morwen's Apothecary & Herbalism: Blind herbalist Old Granny Morwen's tinctures & salves.
7. Feldepost's Inn & Tavern: Barnaby's coaching inn, deep beer cellar & Room #4 upstairs.
8. Miller's Hearth Bakery (& 8b. Shed): Tobias Miller's bakery + western grain shed by windbreak.
9. Cobbler's Lane (Shadow Alley): Dim tenement shortcut behind market stalls; Garrick's den.
10. Town Hall, Archives & Stonecrest: Council records (Scribe Vane) & Alderman Durlag's hall.
11. Town Watch Barracks & Armory: Captain Rebecca Thorne's muster yard & fallout bunker.
12. The Jovial Juggler Inn & Taproom: Southern thatched roadhouse for travelers & performers.
III. SOLSTICE CARNIVAL BOOTHS (AT BASE OF CHURCH #4)
[A] Solar Bullseye Archery (Sister Althea): DC 13 Ranged/Dex ➔ Morninglord Ribbon.
[B] Blindfold Herb Tasting (Granny Morwen): DC 13 Med/Nature ➔ Cooling Lozenges.
[C] Anvil-Ringer Striker (Master Smith Taerom): DC 14 Athletics ➔ Smith's Whetstone.
[D] Honey-Currant Pie Sprint (Tobias Miller): DC 12 Con / 13 Dex ➔ Baker's Pin & Buns.
[E] Solstice Rhyme Duel (Elorion & Pip): DC 13 Perf/Sleight ➔ Harmonic Chime Inspiration.
★ Morning Festival Hours: 06:30 AM – 09:30 AM • High Sun Town Muster at #3: 11:00 AM Sharp
